items.title: Star Ferry: Tsim Sha Tsui → Central
items.hours: Central ↔ TST runs 06:30–23:30. Weekday (Wed 9 Dec) frequency: every 6 min until ~09:45–09:55, then every 6–8 min until ~20:30–20:40, then every 10–12 min.
items.cost: Adult, Monday–Friday (excl. public holidays): upper deck HK$5.0, lower deck HK$4.0. Four-Day Tourist Pass HK$50 (unlimited Central–TST and Wan Chai–TST rides for 4 days).
items.getThere: Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry Pier on Salisbury Road by the Clock Tower; tap Octopus at the gate. Arrives at Central Star Ferry Pier, next to ifc mall and Hong Kong Station.
highlights: Upper deck costs HK$1 more than the lower deck on weekdays (HK$5.0 vs HK$4.0); no reserved seating — sit anywhere.
Central pier side: Central Harbourfront Promenade and the Hong Kong Observation Wheel are beside the pier.
tips: Octopus is simplest. Cash is HKD only: HK$10/HK$20 notes and coins, change given. Self-service machines take credit cards, Alipay, WeChat Pay and UnionPay QuickPass and issue one ticket per person.
The Four-Day Tourist Pass is sold only at the TST pier Control Centre (near Mammy Pancake).
TST pier has a 7-Eleven, % Arabica and restrooms if you need a pre-crossing stop.
items.watch: No eating or drinking on board; no standing on the upper deck until docked. Bags limited to 40 × 40 × 17.5 cm. Sailing times can vary with marine traffic and weather.

items.title: Central / Sheung Wan Compact Urban Route
items.cost: Free to walk. Tourist reward (27 Jul–31 Dec 2026): spend HK$200+ in one same-day transaction at participating Old Town Central merchants for a limited-edition Street Sign Pin, while stocks last.
items.getThere: From Central Star Ferry Pier walk inland to Queen's Road Central. Old Town Central is bounded by Wyndham Street, Possession Street, Queen's Road Central and Caine Road; Sheung Wan's dried-goods streets are just west.
highlights: Hollywood Road: galleries, cafés, murals and heritage sites; HKTB notes Time Out ranked it the world's second-coolest street.
Central–Mid-Levels Escalator: 800 m covered system from Queen's Road Central to Conduit Road, 16 escalators plus 3 travelators.
Dried Seafood & Tonic Food Street (Des Voeux Road West, Wing Lok Street, Bonham Strand West): shop fronts of dried scallops, shrimp, fish maw, ginseng, dried berries and roots — a look-only street.
tips: The escalator runs DOWNHILL 06:00–10:00 and uphill only from 10:20 — during this 9–10 AM slot walk the stairs beside it.
Pick up a free Old Town Map (street-sign designs) while stocks last.
items.watch: The escalator does not reach The Peak (HKTB states this explicitly).

items.title: Climb to the Peak → Lugard Road → High West
items.hours: Public roads and country-park trail; no gates. Go in daylight.
items.getThere: Old Peak Road climbs from the Robinson Road junction (Mid-Levels) to Victoria Gap; the upper part is a pedestrian-only slope. From the Peak Tower, Lugard Road starts the AFCD Peak Trail (High West Section); High West is a branch off it.
highlights: Old Peak Road was the original route to the summit (built 1920s, formerly 'Peak Road'); one of six surviving Victoria City Boundary Markers stands on it.
Lugard Road (built 1913–14): century-old plank-road sections over the cliff with the classic Victoria Harbour panorama; Lugard Road Lookout is at 31 Lugard Road, ~20 min from the Peak Tower.
High West viewing point (AFCD): 180° view west over Tsing Yi, Lantau and Lamma; AFCD also lists the High West artillery observation post (西高山砲兵觀察所) nearby.
tips: AFCD rates the full Peak Trail (High West Section) 4 km / 2.5 h, difficulty 2 of 5 (普通); doing just Lugard Road + the High West spur and returning is shorter.
The whole Peak Circle Walk loop (Lugard + Harlech Roads) is 3.5 km and about 1 hour per HKTB.
Water/food only at Peak Tower, Peak Galleria, and a kiosk in Victoria Peak Garden — none on Lugard Road or High West.
Check HKO's Hiking Trail Weather Service before climbing.
items.watch: AFCD: Lugard Road edges and the High West cliffs are weathered and steep — stay on the road/built path and never cross railings. If cloud covers the Peak, views vanish (see rain plan).

items.title: Taxi Down to Wan Chai
items.cost: Red urban taxi: HK$29 for the first 2 km, then HK$2.1 per 200 m (or per minute waiting) until the meter reaches HK$102.5, HK$1.4 thereafter. HK$6 per bag carried in the boot.
items.getThere: Pick up near Peak Tower / Peak Galleria; ask for 希慎廣場 Hysan Place, 500 Hennessy Road, Causeway Bay. Public-transport fallback: bus 15 / X15 or green minibus 1 from Peak Galleria to Central, then MTR Island Line Central → Causeway Bay.
tips: Ask for a machine-printed receipt; drivers must issue one on request.
Carry small notes: drivers are not obliged to change HK$500/HK$1,000.

items.title: Causeway Bay → Happy Valley on Foot and by Tram
items.getThere: Board a tram showing 'Happy Valley' — route 2 (Happy Valley ↔ Shau Kei Wan) or route 5 (Kennedy Town ↔ Happy Valley) — and ride to the Happy Valley terminus beside the racecourse on Wong Nai Chung Road.
tips: Pay when you exit at the FRONT door: Octopus, Visa/Mastercard/UnionPay/JCB/Amex contactless, Apple/Google Pay, or QR (AlipayHK, WeChat Pay). No change for cash.
Aim to reach the racecourse gates as they open; on a nine-race night they may open earlier than two hours before race 1 (see index 6).
items.watch: From 1.5 h before the first race, Wong Nai Chung Road southbound (Queen's Road East → racecourse) closes to most traffic, so road travel around the course slows.

items.title: Happy Valley — International Jockeys' Championship
items.hours: LONGINES IJC confirmed for Wed 9 Dec 2026, Happy Valley night meeting (9 turf races, 1000–1800 m). First race 6:40 or 7:10 PM (card not yet published); gates open 2 h before race 1, earlier when >8 night races. Last race ~11:00 PM.
items.cost: Public Enclosure: free for visitors 18+ with a valid passport/travel document (otherwise HK$10 by Octopus). Members Enclosure Tourist Badge on IJC night: HK$190 (passport required at purchase).
items.getThere: Public Enclosure entrance on Wong Nai Chung Road (HKJC names entrance G for the HK$10 Octopus gate).
highlights: IJC format: elite local and overseas jockeys ride four designated races; highest points total wins. Ride allocation is drawn on 7 Dec, press conference 8 Dec.
HKJC top spots: Parade Ring, 1650 m starting gate, Winning Post, Beer Garden food trucks, centre-stage live bands; Racing Academy and virtual-ride simulator on 1/F, Grandstand Gate G.
2/F Track View Terrace has a sweeping track view plus a big screen showing races from multiple angles (HKTB).
tips: Final two IJC places are decided after the 25 Nov meeting; check the HKIR event hub for the full jockey line-up.
HKJC suggests arriving by 9:30 PM at the latest; earlier is better on a big night.
items.watch: No entry under 18. Public Enclosure bans slippers, flip-flops, plastic footwear and offensive clothing; Members Enclosure also bans singlets and sports shorts. HKJC says start times are provisional and may change; check the race card once published.

items.title: Back to TST
items.getThere: MTR: walk to Causeway Bay station, Island Line west to Admiralty, change to Tsuen Wan Line to Tsim Sha Tsui (hotel is at Exit C2). Alternative: Star Ferry Central → TST runs until 23:30.
items.cost: Taxi to Kowloon adds the Cross-Harbour Tunnel charge: HK$25 toll + HK$25 return toll (return toll waived only from a cross-harbour taxi stand).
tips: The Sung Tak Street taxi stand is suspended 5:00–11:59 PM on night meetings; a temporary stand on Wong Nai Chung Road (south of the Members' entrance) runs only from race 3 until the end of the second-last race.

items.title: Late Arcade / Dessert in TST
items.getThere: From Tsim Sha Tsui MTR (Tsuen Wan Line) — the hotel exit C2 is the base.
tips: Decide at the racecourse: if you stay to the final race (~11:00 PM), this slot realistically shrinks to a quick dessert near the hotel.
items.watch: No specific TST arcade with late opening hours could be verified for 9 Dec; confirm hours on the spot before walking over.

conflicts.published: Opening time is 2 hours before the first race, but if there are more than eight races on a night meeting it is brought forward. The Dec 9 fixture lists nine races, so gates may open earlier than 2 h before race 1.
